comment: MCP conformance checks that do not apply to /mcp, a keyless, read-only, stateless server that offers tools only. Each entry names a check as <scenario> or <scenario>:<check-id> of @modelcontextprotocol/conformance (the version mcp.spec.ts pins), what the check needs, and why /mcp lacks it. needs is tool:<name> for a tool the suite defines, capability:<name> for a server capability, or schema:<keyword> for a keyword the check looks for in a tool's input schema. site/test/unit/mcp-not-applicable.test.ts holds every entry to a server that truly lacks what it needs. mcp.spec.ts passes the list to the suite as its expected failures, so a check here that starts to pass fails the run. ai.mcp_conformance_share counts these checks apart: its share is passed over the checks that apply.
